Very unstable, Not reliable
Aug 2018 • Family
I have been a big fan of this banh mi place but I feel I must say this here for them to really start to care their quality of food and service. 
Very often, they forget to put something in my banh mi : so after a few failures, I started to watch over as they make my BM. 
This morning, they got my order and started to make it. Then I saw no raddish was put in, so I pointed out. Then, they said they did not have raddish! They were going to give me my BM without one of major ingrediants. 
I love this place so I hope they do something about overall management of this place. Please!
And, plus, please also do something about flies : too many flies here!

Delicious bahn mi
Dec 2017 • Friends
Saw a queue outside Bahh Mi 362 at 10am and decided to take away a couple to try. U wasnt disappointed! Had one with the mixed vietnamese ham and another with grilled pork. The ham were fresh and the pate they spread on the baguettes were almost like feied pate vs the normal wet ones. The taste was well balanced with a couple of yellow chili slices thrown in for kicks. The grilled pork were delicious and tasted more like minced pork cutlets instead of grilled meat.

Just okay
Aug 2017 • Family
This place is nothing special, bread is fine, ingredients okay. The big problem is that they can't get the order right. Ordered 4 sandwiches, asked for 3 of them with no peppers or veggies, only wanted the meat. They stuffed peppers and veggies in all of them, I didn't think to check it, assuming that it was an easy order for them, left in a taxi to get back to hotel and saw it was all wrong. Normally not a big deal to pull out the veggies, but the kids can't have hot chili sauce on it, and that was spread over the bread, so they couldn't eat the sandwich they tried but it was burning their mouths. Is was a waste, you have one job!
